comparison.objective: Screen media from washers vs extend and relock a telescoping paint-roller pole.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual screen load sharing and agitation vs counter-twist tubes to release a twist lock, slide to a mark, then torque-lock.
comparison.success_condition: Mass-based separation with no loss and stable released screen vs target pole length, lock engagement, torque/holding integrity, and release.
comparison.reason: Twist-lock manipulation and calibrated extension do not overlap with granular separation.
